page.title: Profiles & Orchestration
page.subtitle: A profile is a saved assistant: how it works through requests, its models, tools, memory, and computers.
page.hint: Choose one in Chat, or create your own.
page.emptyDescription: Create a profile to tell Chat how your assistant should work.

create.title: Create profile
create.startingWith: Starting with {{name}}. You can rename and fine-tune after creating.

coding.label: Programming
coding.description: Code help with an AI team across your computers.

blank.label: Blank
blank.description: Start empty and set roles, tools, and computers yourself.

menu.confirmReset: Reset “{{name}}” to how Toskar ships it? Your changes to it are lost.

auto.label: Auto
auto.detail: Toskar decides: quick questions get one model, requests with several parts are planned and checked.

single.label: Single model
single.detail: One model answers every request, without a plan.

planned.label: Planner + workers
planned.detail: Requests with several parts are always worked through in parts before the answer is written.

team.label: Team
team.detail: A planner splits each request, workers do the parts (on other computers when they can), and a reviewer checks the answer. Quick questions are still answered directly.

prefer_local.title: Prefer this computer
prefer_local.detail: Tries to run on this machine first. Falls back to a paired computer when a model is not installed here.

manual.title: Custom
manual.detail: Uses role pins for placement. Ideal when you want a specific step on a specific machine.

automatic.title: Automatic
automatic.detail: Places each step on whichever paired computer already has the model. No IP or port setup.

help.assistant: Writes the answer. Automatic uses the model chosen in the chat.
help.fast: Answers quick questions when the chat is on Auto.
help.coding: Answers coding requests when the chat is on Auto.
help.worker: Works on one part of a plan. Parts can run on different computers at once.
help.reviewer: Checks the answer before you see it.
help.other: A named step in this profile’s workflow.

internet.label: Internet
internet.description: Search and read current information from the web, and find places and directions

files.label: Files
files.description: Find, read, and write files in the workspace

code.label: Run code
code.description: Run Python in a sandbox for calculations, analysis, and charts; asks first

speech.label: Speech
speech.description: Transcribe audio and read text aloud, on this computer

images.label: Images
images.description: Make and edit images on this computer, once image generation is set up

browser.label: Browser
browser.description: Use web pages in an isolated browser; clicking, typing, and downloading ask first

video.label: Video
video.description: Make short clips on this computer, once video generation is set up

git.label: Git
git.description: Inspect the repository, and commit or push

automations.label: Automations
automations.description: Set up tasks that run on a schedule from chat; you confirm each one

search.label: Web search
search.description: Searches the public web and returns titles, links, and snippets.

open.label: Open web page
open.description: Opens a URL and returns readable text.

search.label: Find files
search.description: Finds files in the workspace by name.

read.label: Read file
read.description: Lets the assistant open files inside your Toskar workspace so it can quote or summarize real content.

write.label: Write file
write.description: Lets the assistant create or update files in the workspace.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.description: Runs shell commands on this computer.

status.label: Git status
status.description: Shows which files are changed so the assistant can reason about your working tree.

diff.label: Git diff
diff.description: Shows the actual code changes so the assistant can review or explain a patch.

log.label: Git log
log.description: Shows recent commits in the workspace.

add.label: Git add
add.description: Stages files for commit. Useful when you want help preparing a commit.

ask.label: Ask each time
ask.description: Shows an in-chat prompt before every use.

allow-for-session.label: Ask once per session
allow-for-session.description: Prompts the first time, then remembers until you restart the app.

allow.label: Always allow
allow.description: Runs without asking. Best for low-risk tools you use often.

editor.name: Name
editor.modelsHint: Automatic uses the model chosen in the chat.
editor.fallbackHint: Tried in order when the answering model fails. After these, Toskar picks another installed model.
editor.memoryHint: Chats with this profile search these sources on every question and use the matching passages.

selectionOptions.automatic: Automatic — place where the model already lives
selectionOptions.manual: Custom — use the computers set in Models

editor.localOnly: Only this computer — never use paired computers

effort.label: Reasoning level
effort.help: Used when a chat leaves effort on Auto.

planning.label: Planning
planning.help: Work through requests with several parts in parts. Always also splits requests with no obvious parts.

parallel.label: Parallelism
parallel.help: Look up independent parts side by side.

verification.label: Verification
verification.help: Check figures against the sources before answering.

memory.label: Memory
memory.help: Use persistent memories in this profile’s chats.

fallback.label: Fallback
fallback.help: Answer on another model when the chosen one fails.

max_tool_calls.label: Tool calls
max_tool_calls.help: Most tool calls in one turn (1–50).

retries.label: Retries
retries.help: Tries after a model fails (1–3): the same model on another computer, then another model.

timeout_seconds.label: Time limit (s)
timeout_seconds.help: Stop a turn that runs longer (10–3600).

context_share.label: Context budget
context_share.help: Most of the window earlier messages may use (0.1–0.9).
